english: Let $\overrightarrow{a}$ and $\overrightarrow{b}$ be two vectors of equal magnitude such that $\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ and $\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{b}=6\hat{i}-6\hat{j}$. Then the value of $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}$ is ______.
hindi: माना $\overrightarrow{a}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{b}$ समान परिमाण वाले दो सदिश इस प्रकार हैं कि $\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{b}=6\hat{i}-6\hat{j}$ है। तब $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: Put $\overrightarrow{s}=\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ and $\overrightarrow{d}=\overrightarrow{a}-\overrightarrow{b}$. Since $|\overrightarrow{a}|=|\overrightarrow{b}|$, these are the diagonals of a rhombus.
Dot product: $\overrightarrow{s}\cdot\overrightarrow{d}=|\overrightarrow{a}|^2-|\overrightarrow{b}|^2=0$, so the diagonals are perpendicular.

Taking magnitudes, with the angle between $\overrightarrow{s}$ and $\overrightarrow{d}$ equal to $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$: $|\overrightarrow{s}||\overrightarrow{d}|=2|\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{b}|=2\sqrt{36+36}=12\sqrt2$.

Check by finding the vectors: $\overrightarrow{d}\perp\overrightarrow{s}$ and $\overrightarrow{s}\times\overrightarrow{d}=-12\hat{i}+12\hat{j}$ give $\overrightarrow{d}=\dfrac{2(\overrightarrow{s}\times(\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{b}))}{|\overrightarrow{s}|^2}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-4\hat{k}$, so $\overrightarrow{a}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-\hat{k}$, $\overrightarrow{b}=3\hat{k}$; indeed $|\overrightarrow{a}|=|\overrightarrow{b}|=3$, $\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{b}=6\hat{i}-6\hat{j}$ and $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}=-3$.
originality_note: New: two vectors are known only through their sum, their cross product and equal length; the rhombus diagonals s and d are perpendicular, |s||d| = 2|a x b| gives |d|, and a.b = (|s|^2 - |d|^2)/4 (way 4, hidden configuration). Closest known: 'diagonals of a parallelogram are given, find its area' and 'solve r x a = b with r.c given'. Different because: the data are a sum and a cross product, and the equal-length condition is what turns them into perpendicular diagonals.

concept_use.Application of cross product: s x d = -2 a x b and |s x d| = |s||d| for perpendicular vectors give |d|^2 = 24.

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, vector and point is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked consistency: (a+b).(a x b) = 12 - 12 = 0 as required, and the data determine a, b uniquely (a = 2i+2j-k, b = 3k). Changed: No change.
key_step: Seeing a+b and a-b as perpendicular rhombus diagonals with |s x d| = 2|a x b|.
justification: Two ideas linked (perpendicular diagonals from equal lengths, the cross product of the diagonals), with no options; the direct route of solving for a needs a vector triple product. Comparable to 2021-P1-Q19 (L3) for combining dot and cross data.
